sections.text:
Remove the brushes of 
generator, exciter and earthing brushes from their holders

Before and after cleaning 
brushes slip ring contact measure the insulation resistance between slip ring 
and earth by using megger device 500 V.D.C approximately
≥ 10 MΩ

قبل وبعد التنظيف 
يقوم حاملو الفرش بقياس مقاومة العزل بين الحاملين والأرض عن طريق 
باستخدام جهاز الميجر 500 فولت دي سي" تقريبا ≥10 MΩ 
"(recording in table 2)

Put holders in their 
position and tightening it

Check the clearance 
between brushes holders and slip ring "approximately 3 m.m"

Replace the brush by a new 
one if its height falls to 25 mm.

Check brushes must move freely in the holders and must sit 
 to the rings by their full surface.

Check brush pressure in permanently given by the 
 holding-down system of the holders.
Check connection of cables of brushes must be tightened.

Measure the 
 current in each brush and recording it in table (1) :if the current in any 
 brush less than 10 A (according to the recommendation from specialist), 
 replaced it"

Measure the 
 leakage AC voltage between bearings of generator as fig (1) "approximately
 ≥ 2 فولت تيار متردد
